description: Submission of Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.08 of 2025 for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 10 13 for the importation of GR 11/Ponni Samba rice variety, which is equivalent to Kiri Samba rice classified under the HS Code 1006.30.29, without obtaining import control licenses. In order to give effect to the said Cabinet decision, the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.08 of 2025, made under the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act No.1 of 1969, have been published through Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2458/43 dated 2025-10-15. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
